title: Arkret Protocol Journey Wire Contracts
description: Closed wire carriers shared by bootstrap, Contact, stable Direct Conversation, participation, membership recovery, history, KeyPackage terminal handling and Sidecar staging.

deployment_ceiling_core.description: Unsigned, digest-free deployment-ceiling transcript. Its canonical digest is computed over this exact core; neither the digest nor a completeness root appears inside the core.

deployment_ceiling_completeness_core.description: Closed, unsigned completeness transcript. completeness_root is computed over this exact core and therefore is intentionally absent here.

deployment_ceiling_fork_repair.description: The successor is the unique synthetic merge: predecessor_set equals the canonical-sorted fork head digests, successor.version is covered_through_version+1, and successor.predecessor_digest equals completeness_root. These cross-field equalities and the target-authority single-write CAS are mandatory evaluator checks.

effect_value_core.description: Immutable external-effect business value. It intentionally contains no view or certificate.

qda_receipt.description: Each receipt repeats destination and all effect identity coordinates; evaluators require them to equal the referenced EffectValueCore byte-for-byte.

qda_certificate.description: Closed digest-free qDA certificate core. destination and all effect identity coordinates MUST equal the exact EffectValueCore and every contained receipt; signer identities are distinct and canonically sorted by the registered evaluator.

membership_compensation_action.description: Closed action selector. Subject and original join actor identities occur only once in membership_compensation_delegation_core; evaluators require leave for a self-authored join and remove for a delegated/admin-authored join.

membership_compensation_delegation_core.description: Unsigned and identifier-free canonical delegation core. delegation_digest is computed over this exact core; neither the outer delegation_id, digest nor signature is part of the core.

membership_compensation_executor_delegat.description: Content-addressed signed delegation. delegation_id MUST equal ak:membership-compensation-delegation:sha256:<hex>, where <hex> is exactly the suffix of delegation_digest=sha256:<hex> recomputed from the closed core.

protected.description: Detached JWS protected header. Decoded JSON is closed to alg and kid; alg is from the CI allowlist and kid resolves under configured issuer trust roots.
